summary: Design risk-linked controls, document evidence and plan remediation with practical internal control systems training. Explore the course outline.
lede: Internal controls training helps professionals connect process objectives and risks to workable controls, owners and evidence. It is for internal controls analysts, process owners and risk specialists who document, operate or assess controls. Participants practise validating workflows through walkthroughs, building risk and control matrices, defining control evidence and planning corrective actions for identified gaps.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who document, operate, assess or improve internal controls and need to connect process risks with workable control activities and evidence.
prerequisites: Recommended background: experience designing, documenting or improving organizational controls, or working with process owners on workflows and risks. No programming is required. Exercises use process documentation, risk and control matrices, spreadsheets and document editors.
